name: World Meteorological Organization
body: HSTS is sent with preload, every image analyzed has alt text, and language versions link back to each other. But the sitemap lists 878 community.wmo.int URLs, and search engines skip sitemap URLs from another host.
lesson: Keep each sitemap to its own host. Give each subdomain its own sitemap, named in that subdomain's robots.txt.
summary: wmo.int scores 83 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 891 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 891 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: community.wmo.int (878), iclimateaction.org (8), ig3is.wmo.int (3) and 2 more. The sitemap should list only URLs on https://wmo.int.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 5 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Language alternates point at each other
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
